RESTORE those two lines so transition_mod matches the committed baseline (check git show HEAD:build.zig for the correct lines).

(2) VERIFY the two test files compile and are wired: tests/integration/validation_vld_unit_test.zig (14 blocks) and tests/integration/validation_vld_http_test.zig (5 blocks) must be reachable. Check `git status` — they are currently untracked. Confirm each file is complete (proper imports, no truncation, no error.SkipZigTest, no hardcoded UUIDs). Fix any defects.

(3) WIRE into tests/integration/main_test.zig using the existing SPC-01 import-as-comptime pattern (e.g. `const _vld_unit = @import("validation_vld_unit_test.zig"); const _vld_http = @import("validation_vld_http_test.zig");`).

(6) COMMIT on the feature branch with a conventional message (e.g. `test(validation): wire VLD-01/02/03 spec tests into integration suite`). Include the two test files, build.zig fix+wiring, main_test.zig wiring, and any supporting shims needed to make the tests reach the handler (e.g. the src/bpm.zig validation_routes re-export if present).

(7) Update this handoff file with status=COMPLETED, result.status=PASS, result.artifacts_out (test files + build.zig + main_test.zig + commit SHA), result.test_count_produced=19 (14+5), completed_at=now via python tools/utcnow.py.
